All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

---

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Customer `fwod37-n1 Bench Customer` created and saved (res.partner id 44), with City = `Benchville`. Verified twice after save and again read-only at the end: Name = `fwod37-n1 Bench Customer`, City = `Benchville`.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Quotation `S00021` created for that customer with one order line: product `[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens`, quantity 3. Unit price auto-filled by the app: **£295.00**. Untaxed amount computed: **£885.00** (TAX 20% £177.00, Total £1,062.00). Note: the first product attempted was "Customizable Desk", which showed a £0.00 unit price, so I switched to Acoustic Bloc Screens to get a demonstrably auto-filled non-zero price. The initial save was blocked by a leftover "Configure your product" modal; a follow-up save succeeded and the record was assigned reference **S00021**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Second order line added via "Add a product": product `[FURN_7777] Office Chair`, quantity 2, unit price auto-filled **£70.00** (line subtotal £140.00). New untaxed amount: **£1,025.00** (TAX 20% £205.00, Total £1,230.00). First line unchanged.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** First line's quantity changed from 3 to 5 (unit price still £295.00, line subtotal £1,475.00). New untaxed amount: **£1,615.00** (TAX 20% £323.00, Total £1,938.00). Second line unchanged (Office Chair, qty 2, £140.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Quotation confirmed via the Confirm button. Order reference: **S00021**. Status shown: **"Sales Order"** (statusbar stages present: Sales Order | Quotation Sent | Quotation, with "Sales Order" checked; Confirm button replaced by Create Invoice / Send by Email / Cancel).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Sales order cancelled via the Cancel button plus the "Cancel Sales Order" wizard (chose plain "Cancel", not "Send and cancel", so no email was sent). Status shown after cancelling: **"Cancelled"** (statusbar: Cancelled | Sales Order | Quotation Sent | Quotation, with "Cancelled" checked; a "Set to Quotation" button now appears). Nothing created by this run remains active.
